name: Meme Search
description: Meme Search is a self-hosted search engine for your own meme collection. A local vision model writes a description of each image, and the memes can then be found by keyword or by meaning, tagged, and fetched through a read-only search API.

notes.text: Meme Search has no login. Anyone who reaches port 3000 can delete memes, change settings and create API tokens, so keep it on a trusted network or behind a VPN.
After an IP change or behind a reverse proxy, add the new IP or host name to MEME_SEARCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS in /opt/memesearch_data/.env and run systemctl restart memesearch.
To index memes from the host, bind-mount them as a subfolder of /opt/memesearch_data/memes (symlinks are rejected) and add that folder under Settings.
